SYMPTOM: `execFile('claude', ['-p', 'prompt'])` from Node.js server hangs indefinitely, zero output, even with PIXEL_OFFICE_HAIKU=1 env var
CAUSE: Claude CLI waits for stdin input when no TTY is present. execFile doesn't close stdin.
FIX: Use exec() with shell:true and append `< /dev/null` to the command string:
  exec(`PIXEL_OFFICE_HAIKU=1 claude -p '${prompt}' --model haiku --max-turns 1 --strict-mcp-config < /dev/null`, {timeout: 15000}, callback)
PREVENT: Any subprocess spawn of claude CLI must close stdin. `< /dev/null` is the reliable fix.
